May 13, 2018 - By Vivian Park
Selway Asset Management increased its stake in Schlumberger Ltd (SLB) by 28% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Selway Asset Management bought 12,074 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.39% with the market. The institutional investor held 55,200 shares of the oilfield services and equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.72M, up from 43,126 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Selway Asset Management who had been investing in Schlumberger Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $98.46B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.06% or $0.04 during the last trading session, reaching $71.08. About 5.45 million shares traded. Schlumberger Limited (NYSE:SLB) has declined 16.28% since May 13, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.83% the S&P500.

The institutional investor held 4,865 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $746,000, down from 7,036 at the end of the previous reported quarter.
